- - 0.26% Max Estates continues to invest in technologies, systems, and design interventions that enhance environmental performance, occupant well-being, and responsible operations across its developments. While such investments are integrated into the Company's overall project development and capital expenditure programs and are not tracked separately as a percentage of total R&D or capex expenditure, key initiatives include: Environmental Stewardship » Water and energy metering systems for granular resource monitoring. » Cooling-as-a-Service at Max Towers and other energy- efficient HVAC solutions. » Low-flow fixtures, on-site STPs, and automated water leakage detection systems (under implementation). » Double-glazed façades to reduce heat gain and cooling demand. » LED lighting and sensor-based lighting controls in common areas. » Rooftop solar infrastructure and procurement of renewable power through off-site PPAs, including at Max Square. » 100% diversion of operational waste from landfill. » Use of low-VOC paints, fly ash-based materials, and AAC blocks. » Evaluation of dual-fuel kits for DG sets to improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions. Health, Safety and Well-being » Advanced air filtration systems and real-time indoor air quality monitoring. » Integration of biophilic design elements to enhance occupant well-being. » Design and operational measures focused on occupant comfort and wellness. Good Governance and Responsible Operations » Deployment of digital monitoring and building management systems to improve operational oversight, resource efficiency, and performance tracking. » Integration of sustainability and well-being considerations into project planning, design, construction, and operations. These investments reflect Max Estates' commitment to creating sustainable, resource-efficient, and well-being-oriented developments while supporting long-term value creation.
